sources.verified: Total input is input_tokens plus cache_read_input_tokens plus cache_creation_input_tokens.
Base input/output fields are required; cache counts are optional and default to None in the SDK.
cached_tokens and cache_write_tokens are optional prompt detail fields with default zero.
Cache usage details are components within the inclusive input total; they are not added a second time.
prompt_eval_count is tokens in the prompt; prompt_eval_cached_count is prompt tokens read from cache.
Input usage should include cached tokens; detailed usage attributes are subsets of aggregate totals.
Published correction of Anthropic input normalization and converted-path cache-write double counting.
